Basics of Good Sleep Hygiene
Good sleep hygiene refers to habits that support consistent,
uninterrupted, quality sleep.
Recommended Sleep Hygiene Habits: - Be Consistent: Go to bed at the same
time each night and get up at the same time each morning, including on
weekends. - Environment: Make sure your bedroom is quiet, dark, relaxing,
and at a comfortable temperature. - Electronic Devices: Remove TVs,
computers, and smartphones from the bedroom; avoid screen exposure 30-60
minutes before bed. - Avoid Large Meals & Stimulants: Avoid heavy meals,
caffeine, and alcohol before bedtime.
